committed_before: the held-out sample (search seed 807000000000000002) was drawn; no code of an early end was written
question: At zero temperature, does a chunk's own record of each deciding chain's late descent (the energy it fell over the chunk's last quarter of moves, as a share of its whole descent, and the improving moves it accepted there a node) tell, before the multiplier's cap, that the seed will reach the cap still falling (RELAXING_AT_CEILING), so that it could end there with that class, while never ending a seed that would come to rest (AT_REST) or whose chain from empty would cross the mean-degree cap?
decided: the operator, 2026-11-19 04:12: 'we want to detect & park as efficiently as possible', deterministically, from the chain's own dynamics; docs/agent/NEXT_BUILD.md at 806: 'If the measurement finds no early end that keeps every chain's class, say so and make none'

calibration.sample: a_design's first campaign on the shipped spec, search seed 807000000000000001, the first 400 zero-temperature laws of 1,000 drawn; 256 nodes (all 400 laws) and 1,024 (the first 200), two seeds each; 1,200 seeds grown on 806's code with no budget, each to its own end; frozen as grown when this file was written
calibration.classes: 975 at rest (80 of them classed OPERATIONAL_UNRESOLVED by 806 after a pass at the cap: cap_pass_criterion.json), 175 at the mean-degree cap, 50 relaxing at the cap (22 laws)

one_chunk.reading: on the chunk before the cap, a seed that went on to rest (or to cross the mean-degree cap) had a falling chain with a share of 0.918 and one with 3.83 improving moves a node; no relaxing seed read above either (its highest 0.50 and 2.18), so a threshold on either that ends any relaxing seed ends a seed of another class

calibration.persistence_reading: a chain falling with a share above a threshold on 2 or 3 chunks in a row, thresholds 0.01 to 0.1: every such rule ends at least 5 seeds that did not end relaxing
calibration.why: zero-temperature descent comes in bursts: a chain at rest for three chunks falls again, and one whose last quarter fell 18% of its whole descent at x32 rests over the last eighth of x64; whether a chain is at rest at the cap is decided by its last improving moves, which its earlier chunks do not foretell

finding: no early end read from a chunk's own late descent keeps every chain's class; none is made, and zero temperature is read at the cap as before

held_out.sample: search seed 807000000000000002, its first 200 zero-temperature laws, 256 and 1,024 nodes, two seeds each, grown on 806's code with no budget, each to its own end
predicted: P1: on the chunk before the cap, no relaxing seed has a falling chain whose late descent share is above that of every seed that comes to rest or crosses the mean-degree cap
P2: the same for the improving moves a node in the late window
P3: each persistence rule above (thresholds 0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.08 and 0.1, on 2 and on 3 chunks in a row, the same chain) ends at least one seed that does not end relaxing
held_out.shown: the relaxing seeds' share of the zero-temperature work, and that of their last chunk: what any early end could at most have saved

passes_when: P1, P2 and P3 hold: the measurement then confirms that no such early end keeps every class, and none is made
